name: SSL Certificate Expiry Check (Cronsole)
description: Connect to a host over TLS and fail the run when its certificate expires within your warning window. Cronsole has no certificate probe yet, so this uses a Node script and the built-in tls module rather than a check job.

parameters.label: Host
parameters.help: Hostname to connect to, resolved from the machine running the Cronsole backend.

parameters.label: Warn within (days)
parameters.help: Fail the run when fewer than this many days remain before the certificate expires.
